senses.gloss:
a. (-पी f.) [कूप-अण्] Relating to or coming from a well (as water). 
-पम् Well-water.

[कूप-खञ्; see [[Sk.]] on शालीनकौपीने अधृष्टाकार्ययोः [[P. V. 2. 20]]] 
__1 The pudenda. 
__2 A privity, privy part. 
__3 A small piece of cloth (usually a small strip worn over the privities; कौपीनं शतखण्डजर्जरतरं कन्था पुनस्तादृशी [[Bh. 3. 101.]] 
__4 (Hence sometimes) A ragged or tattered garment. 
__5 Sin, an improper or wrong act; नाच्छादयति कौपीनं न दंशमशकापहम् [[Pt. 3. 97.]]
